name: jrcmo-brain
description: Look up Joshua Ramsey's 37 marketing laws from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
The JRcmo Brain gives ChatGPT access to Joshua Ramsey's 37 marketing laws: the rules he has developed over 25+ years in marketing and applies to his clients' campaigns.

When you ask a marketing question, ChatGPT can use the JRcmo Brain to look up the laws that relate to your question and read their full text. Each law explains what is true, why, and how to apply it. ChatGPT then uses those laws in its answer.

The JRcmo Brain has three read-only tools:
- Find laws: matches your described marketing problem to the most relevant laws.
- Get a law: returns the full text of one law, numbered 0 to 36.
- List laws: returns all 37 laws with a one-line summary of each.

Topics the laws cover include advertising, lead generation, headlines and website copy, marketing budgets, conversion tracking, pricing, and visibility in AI search.

The laws are general marketing guidance, not a guarantee of any result. The JRcmo Brain doesn't connect to your ad accounts, analytics or website, and doesn't analyze your data itself. It needs no account or login, and it only looks up marketing laws: it can't see your other conversations, files or accounts.
defaultPrompt: My Google Ads report shows 14.62 conversions this month. Should I trust that number?
My ads get clicks but no leads. Which marketing law am I breaking, and what do I fix first?
My homepage headline is 'Quality Service You Can Trust.' Which law does it break? Rewrite it.
